    Aggregate Taxa to a Higher Taxonomic Rank

    aggregate_taxa.Rd

    Agglomerates/merges features (ASVs/OTUs) by a specified taxonomic rank (e.g., Phylum, Family, Genus) by summing abundances across all assays using compiled C-level primitives.

    Usage

    aggregate_taxa(tb, rank, na.rm = FALSE)

    Arguments

    tb

    A tidy_microbiome object.

    rank

    Character string specifying the taxonomic column to aggregate by.

    na.rm

    Logical. If TRUE, removes unassigned taxa. If FALSE (default), groups them as "Unclassified".

    Value

    An updated tidy_microbiome object aggregated at the specified rank.

    Examples

    data(gut_microbiome)
tb_phylum <- aggregate_taxa(gut_microbiome, rank = "Phylum")
dim(assay(tb_phylum))
#> [1]  4 24
